common.metaTitle: Sokhan — from speech to text in moments
common.metaDescription: Sokhan turns your speech into accurate Persian text and hands you a short summary — for lectures, meetings, interviews, and voice messages.

landing.headline: From speech to text, in moments
landing.subheadline: Upload an audio file or record straight away — Sokhan turns it into an accurate Persian transcript and hands you a short summary alongside.
landing.featuresSubtitle: From lecture notes to a friend's voice message — every recording deserves its text.
landing.featureLectureDesc: Record a lecture or a meeting and get clean, well-organized text together with a summary — no more frantic note-taking.
landing.featureInterviewDesc: Long interviews become searchable text — stop scrubbing through the whole file just to find one sentence.
landing.featureVoiceDesc: Send a voice message, get its full text, and skim a three-line summary instead of listening to the end.
landing.howSubtitle: Three simple steps from audio to text.
landing.step1Desc: Upload your audio file or record directly right here.
landing.step2Desc: Sokhan listens carefully to your speech and prepares the transcript.
landing.step3Desc: The full transcript and a short summary are ready — read, search, or download them.
landing.ctaDesc: Upload a file or record a few sentences and see the quality of the text and summary for yourself.

login.title: Sign in to Sokhan
login.subtitle: Sign in to see your transcriptions and keep working.
login.codeHint: Have a connect code? No email or password needed.
login.passwordHintRegister: The password must be at least 8 characters.
